Package neqsim.thermo.component

Class IapwsHenryLaw

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.component.IapwsHenryLaw
public final class IapwsHenryLaw extends Object
IAPWS G7-04 Henry-law correlation for common gases at infinite dilution in liquid H2O.

The correlation returns the mole-fraction Henry constant kH = lim(x -> 0) f / x on the water saturation boundary. It does not include a Poynting correction or electrolyte salting-out interaction.

Coefficients and species-specific fitted ranges are from IAPWS G7-04, based on Fernandez-Prini et al., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 32 (2003), doi:10.1063/1.1564818. The IAPWS guideline permits reproduction with attribution.

    • isUsable

      public static boolean isUsable(String componentName, double temperature)
      Tests whether a request lies inside the published species-specific fitted range.

      This allocation-free predicate is intended for the fugacity hot path. Use assess(String, double) when fitted-range diagnostics are needed.

      componentName - NeqSim component name or IAPWS formula
      temperature - temperature in K
      Returns:
      true for a supported species inside its fitted range
